generator.independence_contract: Closed-form world-space phantom, gradients, matrices and landmarks; no candidate library, interpolator, transform basis or optimizer is imported.

holdout_policy.leakage_rule: This manifest is development-only and cannot support an audit or superiority claim. Future selection and audit families receive new immutable manifests before their first use; audit inputs remain unread until settings and thresholds are frozen.

scalar_algebra.estimand: Relative or absolute discrepancy against explicit projected-patch matrices and operator adjoints on well-conditioned Double fixtures.
scalar_algebra.evidence: Use explicit C, P and J implementations plus the independent Python oracles; retain near-zero exceptions separately.

directional_finite_difference.estimand: Best stable plateau discrepancy over the declared central-difference step sweep, away from interpolation knots and support gates.
directional_finite_difference.evidence: Report every step and its error; a single favorable step is insufficient.

rigid_landmark_rms_mm.estimand: RMS fixed-world landmark distance to known noise-free rigid truth for identifiable core fixtures.
rigid_landmark_rms_mm.evidence: All landmarks are scored in world millimetres; failures remain in the fixture denominator.

rigid_rotation_error_degrees.estimand: Geodesic SO(3) error against known noise-free rigid truth for identifiable core fixtures.
rigid_rotation_error_degrees.evidence: Do not derive the angle from optimizer parameter columns.

nonlinear_landmark_rms_mm.estimand: RMS landmark error for independently generated, exactly representable nonlinear development truth.
nonlinear_landmark_rms_mm.evidence: Out-of-basis and noisy cases are separate approximation distributions.

nonlinear_inverse_roundtrip_mm.estimand: Maximum forward-inverse world residual over the declared certified scope.
nonlinear_inverse_roundtrip_mm.evidence: Failure to bracket or converge is a recorded inverse failure, never a dropped point.

failure_accounting.denominator: Every declared fixture-by-initialization run, including crashes, ambiguity, invalid geometry, nonconvergence and unavailable comparator lanes.
